title: New position in 2D
prompt: Same idea with vectors: return the new position after one frame, given the current position and a velocity in pixels per second.
signature: func solve(position: Vector2, velocity: Vector2, delta: float) -> Vector2:
starter:
func solve(position: Vector2, velocity: Vector2, delta: float) -> Vector2:
	return position + velocity
hint: The starter forgets delta, so it moves a whole second per frame. Scale the velocity first.
solution:
func solve(position: Vector2, velocity: Vector2, delta: float) -> Vector2:
	return position + velocity * delta
